title: Studio in Rainbow ELT Quarter
description: Studio apartment for sale in ELT RAINBOW residential complex (Rainbow, ELT Quarter). Address: 2 Adlia St., Batumi. 12th floor, 32.2 m². Near Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park and Metro City mall; about 150 m to the sea. Well suited for living and rental. Black frame, gas, building completed — ready for renovation. Design project as a gift and discount on renovation works (confirm terms with your manager). Developed ELT Quarter infrastructure: cinema, cafés and restaurants, pharmacies, 24-hour shops, gym. Price $39,000 (USD). Legal support for the transaction through the agency.
